title: Heat-block materials (ADS_CHILL, DRY_COOLER, MAU_HX)
value: ADS_CHILL 304L adsorber shells + silica-gel beds + 316L water coils (PP-H P5 legs); DRY_COOLER copper-tube/aluminium-fin coil + galvanized casing on the HDPE-class closed loop; MAU_HX aluminium-fin/copper-tube heating coil with 316L headers; water sides on the issued M1/P5 families
where: graph params.sec3_material for the three units; duty sheets sections 3
basis: silica gel-water chiller class per WANG2006_ADS; air-cooled exchanger construction per PERRY9_HEAT; drive/chilled classes per A-M-239/240; rejection and make-up-air duties per A-M-244/A-M-241
sensitivity: a drive temperature above 90 C moves ADS_CHILL to 13X zeolite; fin wetting at winter commissioning moves MAU_HX to 316L finned tube
replaced_by: the unit task 12 commissioning/season trials replace the qualitative basis
verification_test: season-commissioning trial: seal leak-down on the adsorbers, coil condition at the dry cooler and make-up-air coil

title: PEM electrolyser stack hardware (H2O_ELYZ)
value: Ti porous transport layers, Ir/Ru mixed-oxide anode + Pt cathode catalyst, PTFE-class ionomer membrane, Ti cell hardware + PTFE seals; product gas lines on the issued M1 316L family; wetted metal-as-electrode under M6 with AQS-REV-H2-001 hydride/reverse-current guards
where: graph params.sec3_material H2O_ELYZ; duty sheet section 3; graph internals
basis: PEM construction classes per IEC62282_3_100 and ISO22734_2019; anode Ir-dissolution basis per BERNT2018; house M6 rule for wetted metal in electrolytic service
sensitivity: electrode loading or duty class moves the stack class (carbon-composite bipolar plates as the replacement stack, same guards)
replaced_by: the unit task 12 PEM bench campaign (X-PAR-12 follow-ups) replaces the literature basis with stack degradation data
verification_test: PEM stack first-article: voltage-hold degradation and membrane condition vs the rated class

title: Polymer sizing-train materials (PELLET, POLY_STOCK)
value: PELLET 316L die plate + cutter hub + UHMW-PE trough liner + PE/PP trough; POLY_STOCK HDPE tote bins + PP powder drums on a steel rack; both units have no corrosive wetted stream
where: graph params.sec3_material for the two units; duty sheets sections 3
basis: wear-limited contact per DIETER1988 and PERRY9_MAT selection logic; store class per A-M-264 and AQS-DUTY-073
sensitivity: measured die wear at the first article moves the cutter face to tungsten carbide; powder charge build moves totes to antistatic PP
replaced_by: the unit task 12 pelletiser first article replaces the qualitative basis
verification_test: pelletiser first-article die/cutter wear inspection

title: SI_REDUCE construction class (GLASS-sector furnace)
value: SI_REDUCE issues as a graphite hot-face carbothermic-reduction furnace + alumina brick backup + mild-steel casing, dry char/silica-class solids handling; the unit has solids-only graph edges and no wetted stream today; its process duty and rates stay a unit task 02 pending item
where: graph params.sec3_material SI_REDUCE; duty sheet section 3
basis: carbonaceous hot-face class per SCHACHT2004 ch. 8; element benchmark CRC_SI for the reduction temperature class; graph closure shows CHAR_TO_SI as the only edge
sensitivity: batch chemistry beyond the graphite class moves the hot face to SiC; the process change is a task 02 decision, not a materials trade
replaced_by: the task 02 sizing and process closure for SI_REDUCE re-opens and owns the duty; at that gate the construction class is re-checked
verification_test: construction-class re-check at the task 02 sizing gate

title: Throughput proportional to the scale factor below the baseline
value: below the baseline (scale factor s < 1) every mass and energy stream scales in proportion to s
basis: AQS-SCALE-001 gives feed 150, 300 and 500 kg/d at cassettes M1, M2 and M3 (close to proportional above the baseline); no layout below the baseline has been sized
sensitivity: if a sub-baseline layout keeps some fixed loads (lighting, life support) the effective s for process sectors is lower and the limits in Tables 4.1 to 4.4 are reached sooner
replaced_by: a sized sub-baseline layout from the scale model
verification_test: size one sub-baseline layout with the scale model and compare its feed with s x 150 kg/d

title: Molten-salt cells held molten between runs
value: FOUNDRY molten-salt cells are kept at bath temperature (hold power) rather than frozen and remelted between runs
where: AQS-SCALE-UR-001 Table 4.2; graph params.sizing.hold_kW of the FOUNDRY cells
basis: freeze-thaw cycling of a lined cell imposes repeated thermal stress on the refractory (SCHACHT2004 ch. 13); cell heat balance per GRJOTHEIM1988
sensitivity: if a cell tolerates freeze-thaw, campaign operation removes the energy penalty in Table 4.2 at small s
replaced_by: lining condition after a planned freeze-thaw trial
verification_test: lining inspection after a planned freeze-thaw trial on one cell

title: Polymer kettle batch size
value: batch product = kettle volume x 0.7 fill x 1.1 kg/L latex density x 0.25 polymer solids
where: AQS-SCALE-UR-001 Table 4.4; flow_graph/param/scale_down.py BATCH_FILL, LATEX_DENSITY_KG_L, LATEX_SOLIDS
basis: emulsion polymerization of fluoromonomers in a stirred kettle (ULLMANN_FLUOROPOLY); fill and solids fraction are study values
sensitivity: batch size sets the days between campaigns and the feed buffer per campaign in proportion
replaced_by: the measured dry polymer mass from the first batch
verification_test: weigh the dried polymer from the first kettle batch

title: Heat-pump condenser fans are electronically commutated (EC) fan motors
value: EXT_HALL heat-pump condenser fans: electronically commutated (EC) fan motor (permanent-magnet motor with integrated electronics), 0.75 kW shaft, rated 1.1 kW at the 1.15 x shaft step (A-M-117), 480 V 3-ph, duty S1, speed control by the integrated EC electronics. No efficiency class is claimed: the IEC 60034-30-1 classes (IE1 to IE4) apply to line-start induction motors
where: AQS-INV-001 (EXT_HALL_N heat pump condenser fan); flow_graph/inventory/motors.py
basis: Common practice for variable-speed condenser fans on air-source heat pumps; the earlier row listed the fan as an IE3 induction motor, which contradicted its EC speed control. Not taken from a selected product
sensitivity: If the selected fan is an induction motor on a variable-frequency drive instead, the motor type, family and spares change; the shaft power and count do not

title: BACKUP_GEN runs on hydrogen first; engine efficiency and hydrogen LHV
value: Dual-fuel spark-ignition engine: 30 % efficiency on hydrogen (the same as on the C5-C10 cut, A-M-134); hydrogen LHV 33.33 kWh/kg (120 MJ/kg)
basis: Owner decision 2026-10-24: the generator is the backup and stays; hydrogen first, another plant fuel when hydrogen is short. Hydrogen LHV is a property value (about 120 MJ/kg); the efficiency is taken equal to the C5-C10 value pending an engine selection
sensitivity: Hydrogen draw S45 and the electrolyser load scale inversely with the efficiency; the C5-C10 reserve does not depend on it
replaced_by: Selected dual-fuel engine data sheet (efficiency at 30 % load on hydrogen)
verification_test: Exercise run on hydrogen at 30 % load: measure fuel mass and electrical output; confirm efficiency within 10 % of 0.30

title: Air density temperatures for gas headers, sanitation superficials and the ZNBR2 purge
value: Gas headers (air and nitrogen class) and the sanitation flue and vent superficials at 20 °C; ZNBR2 purge air at 25 °C. Densities follow from the site pressure and air molar mass by the ideal gas law (flow_graph/param/site.py air_density).
basis: The former density drivers were stated at 20 °C (headers, sanitation); the purge density had no stated temperature and is taken at the 25 °C indoor basis used for insulation.
sensitivity: Density scales with absolute temperature; 5 K changes it by under 2 %.
replaced_by: Operating temperatures from the HVAC design (AQS-THM-002) and the header line lists.
verification_test: Compare with the HVAC design room and line temperatures

basis: NOAA_NORMALS_DV July mean daily maximum, station USC00042319 (1991-2020). Interim: the ASHRAE 0.4 % cooling design dry bulb for the nearest listed station is higher; the interim value understates the design cooling load.
sensitivity: Cooling-rejection sizing, DRY_COOLER approach and the evaporative water charge at the Death Valley variant scale with the design dry bulb.
replaced_by: ASHRAE climatic design conditions (ASHRAE_FUND_2021 ch. 14) for the nearest listed station, or the NSRDB hourly record at the chosen parcel (AQS-PLAN-011 section 6)

value: SDS 0.5 g; SD1 0.27 g; TL 8 s
where: site profile death_valley seismic (binds wt_SDS, wt_SD1)
basis: Interim bounding study values for the Death Valley variant: the Eastern California shear zone is active and the parcel is unfixed, so the interim values are set at about twice the baseline study accelerations until the ASCE Hazard Tool lookup at the parcel replaces them.
sensitivity: Seismic base shear, tank sloshing and anchorage of the variant grow with the spectral accelerations.
replaced_by: ASCE Hazard Tool at the chosen parcel with the site class from the geotechnical report (ASCE7_22)

value: bearing 144 kPa; unit weight 19 kN/m3; bore 20 W/m
where: site profile death_valley ground (binds soil_allow_kPa, soil_unit_weight_kN_m3, ghex capacity)
basis: Interim study values for alluvial-fan ground at the Death Valley variant: presumptive bearing for sandy gravel (IBC 1806 class), moist sandy-gravel unit weight, and the low end of the small-diameter bore band of KAVANAUGH2014 for warm ground.
sensitivity: Foundations, the grounding grid and the ground-loop rejection capacity of the variant.
replaced_by: Geotechnical investigation per IBC 1803 and a thermal response test on the first bore at the parcel

value: heel 5 deg; roll 8 deg; pitch 5 deg; heave 1.5 m/s2
where: site profile floating_island motion group (read by every sizing function that uses apparent gravity)
basis: Interim bounding motion envelope for a moored tropical platform riding out the design storm on its moorings (Q-030/Q-031); magnitudes are class-rule order-of-magnitude placeholders pending site metocean data.
sensitivity: Settlers, flotation, open and stirred tanks, electrowinning cells, the ZNBR2 bromine phase, packed-column bed heights and tank sloshing checks all scale with the motion envelope.
replaced_by: Site metocean data with the class society's environmental load method (CLASS_RULES) and model tests

value: cooling dry bulb 32 C; heating dry bulb 22 C; insulation ambient 27 C
where: site profile floating_island thermal group (binds site_design_dry_bulb_C)
basis: Interim tropical maritime design values for an open-ocean mooring; the ocean moderates both extremes. Understates the humid latent load and is replaced by station or metocean data at the mooring site.
sensitivity: Ventilation and cooling loads, PV cell temperature and the seawater rejection approach temperature of the variant.
replaced_by: Metocean record at the mooring site (CLASS_RULES); ASHRAE climatic data where a coastal station applies
